Helena — thanks, received. Quick next steps from our side:

- We need the VAT registration number (you've included GB123456789 in the certificate — thanks).
- Confirm the legal entity name as it should appear on the invoice (exact registered name and address).
- Tell us the remit-to banking details and whether invoices will be GBP or EUR (one currency per invoice preferred).

A few notes on Redwood's side:
- For UK/EU suppliers we typically route invoices to our EU billing entity (Redwood International Ltd) when the service is consumed in EU/UK to avoid US sales tax complications and to reflect local VAT handling.
- If AstraBridge is supplying services to EU customers of Redwood and invoices should be zero-rated under reverse charge, please indicate B2B VAT handling on the invoice (VAT number for both parties).
- If AstraBridge needs a fiscal representative (for non-EU entities) we will flag that — as a UK company you're within the EU/UK regimes for VAT (post-Brexit rules apply), so fiscal rep is not typical here.

Laura / Ben — can you confirm preferred bill-to entity and PO currency mapping? I'd like to get a PO out this week.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Sourcing Manager — Redwood Inference

Tessa / Ben — I looked over the docs. Proposed routing:

- If the work is provided to Redwood customers or to our EU product teams and delivered in the UK/EU, we should use Redwood International Ltd (EU billing). That keeps VAT accounting consistent.
- For global contracts billed out of the US (rare for operational logistics), we would use Redwood Inc (US) and treat VAT per outbound invoice rules — but only if Helena specifies US bill-to.
- Currency: ask them to submit separate invoices in the currency matching the PO. We will map GBP invoices to the UK AP ledger and EUR to the EU ledger.

Key invoice fields we need (please confirm these are on the invoice sample):
- Invoice number, date, and PO number
- Full supplier legal name and VAT number (exact match to official certificate)
- Remit-to bank details (IBAN / SWIFT) and currency
- Service description with line-level amounts and VAT treatment clearly stated (e.g., "B2B reverse charge — VAT 0% under Article X")

If they will be doing cross-border services into EU member states where they're not registered, we may need a fiscal rep or local VAT registration; Sara can advise and Helena in cc should confirm whether they are registered in other EU countries.

Ben — please prepare a PO template for Redwood International Ltd and I'll review the tax fields. Once PO is ready I'll ask Tessa to issue it.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
